title: Servepath Latency Orthogonalizer: model+route p50/p95/p99 with IO-mode split
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a repeatable dashboard and underlying telemetry contract that decomposes end-to-end latency by model and route with distinct breakdowns for streaming vs non-streaming IO modes. The goal is an orthogonal view (rows: models, columns: routes) with cells showing p50/p95/p99 and ability to expand into trace-linked waterfall and cohort filters (request shape, sequence length, concurrency). This ticket covers the dashboard design, metrics/tagging contract, trace hook additions, logs/metrics pipeline mapping, and rollout to console dashboards.
background: We have multiple ad-hoc latency panels across dashboards; teams need a single sliceable surface that makes it easy to answer: which model-route pairs are regressing for streaming vs blocking requests? Previous work focused on route-centric boards but lacked a compact matrix view plus trace integration and cohort filters. This ticket consolidates those needs into an orthogonal matrix and enforces a low-cardinality metric contract to avoid explosion in time-series volume.
acceptance_criteria: A matrix-style dashboard that shows p50/p95/p99 for every (model, route) cell and allows IO-mode toggle (streaming / non-streaming / both)
Each cell expands to: top 5 traces (with trace links), waterfall breakdown by servepath component, and percentile trend sparkline over 24h/7d/30d
Metrics emitted by serving runtime: latency_histograms and tdigest summaries with labels model, route, io_mode, request_shape, tenant_id; cardinality must be limited to approved label sets
Query examples for p50/p95/p99 available and tested against staging telemetry data
Dashboards include alerts: route-model p95 > configured SLO thresholds for 15m and sustained 6h regression detection
Documentation page for the metric contract and how to add new routes or models without creating high-cardinality label explosions
Rollout to console for internal beta with access control and opt-out flag
tasks: Design dashboard layout and cell UX (matrix + cell drilldown) and get PM/Design signoff
Define metrics contract and approved label values with SRE (list allowed request_shape, model aliases, route stable ids)
Add trace-hook span annotations: servepath_segment, route, model_version, io_mode, request_shape
Instrument runtime to emit tdigest summaries and histogram buckets for per-request end-to-end latency
Update metrics pipeline: map runtime metrics to metrics backend, verify rollup rules and retention
Add logs enrichment for trace_id propagation and request tags for fast lookup in logs UI
Build dashboard panels in Grafana/Console, implement cell expand modal with trace links and waterfall panel
Create PromQL/metrics backend queries and unit tests against synthetic traces in staging
Create alert rules and noise throttling for initial rollout
Alpha rollout to internal teams and gather feedback, then GA
panels_to_build: Orthogonal matrix: rows=models, columns=routes, cell shows p50/p95/p99 numbers and small sparkline
Cell drilldown modal: top traces table (trace_id, duration, start_time, status) with direct link to trace viewer
Waterfall panel: component-level latency stack for selected trace cohort
Heatmap: p95 hotspots across models/routes for selected time range
Percentile trendboard: compare streaming vs non-streaming for selected model-route
Cohort filter bar: request_shape, sequence_length bucket, concurrency bucket, tenant_id (redacted)
metrics_contract: New metric names: rw_e2e_latency_ms_histogram and rw_e2e_latency_tdigest. Required labels: model (alias), route (stable_id), io_mode (streaming|blocking), request_shape (chat|completion|embedding|rerank), seq_len_bucket (0-64,65-256,257-1024,1025+), concurrency_bucket (1,2-8,9+), env (prod|staging). Cardinality constraints: model aliases <= 200, routes <= 400, do not include freeform strings. Tenant_id allowed as high-cardinality tag only in logs, not metrics.
trace_integration: Add standardized span attributes at the start and end of the request servicing path: service=redwood-serving, span.kind=server, attributes: redwood.route.id, redwood.model.alias, redwood.io_mode, redwood.request_shape, redwood.seq_len. Ensure trace_id is returned in runtime response headers for easy linkback. Update middleware to propagate trace_id to downstream adapters (cache, batching router).
logs_pipeline_changes: Enrich application logs with redwood.route.id, redwood.model.alias, redwood.io_mode and trace_id. Ingest logs into the ELK/Kinesis pipeline with a lightweight transform that extracts these labels into indexed fields for fast filtering. Avoid indexing tenant_id in metrics; use log-level lookup for tenant-specific investigations.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 internal alpha in staging dashboard with synthetic data (2 weeks). Phase 2 internal beta with 3 product teams, enable alerting in monitoring but silenced for first 24h (2 weeks). Phase 3 GA: enable alerts, publish docs, and flip default console view (1 week). Rollback: revert dashboard pointer and silence alerts; instrumentation is backward-compatible so rollback is display-only.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: High cardinality from unconstrained model or route labels -> Mitigation: enforce alias mapping and validation in runtime config server
Risk: Metric ingestion volume spike -> Mitigation: emit tdigest summaries and limited histogram buckets, ensure sampling for unusually long tails
Risk: Noise from streaming partial-chunk timing -> Mitigation: define e2e latency as time to last byte for streaming vs time-to-response for blocking; surface both but SLOs use last-byte metric
